title: Smash and Grab at Adrenaline Mountain
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Climb behind the controls of this Big Cat and feel the power it has to crush metal pieces of scraped cars, pick it up, drop it, and basically pulverize it. Your guide will direct you via wireless headset on how to control this Cat 320 Excavator. Whether you're crushing something or burying the shovel into the earth, you will feel the power of this amazing machine. 

Despite being in the desert, you will enjoy amenities such as real restrooms, climate controlled buildings, complimentary chilled bottled water, coffee, and Hot Chocolate, snacks for sale, Wi-Fi, cell phone charging stations, and satellite TV in the guest lounge.
